messages:
priya: Customer (Acme Analytics) reporting large p95 spikes on /v1/chat/completions during their nightly export job. Seeing intermittent ~1.6-2.0s p95 while baseline is ~400ms. Need repro pack: request ids, curl reproductions, promptset, token counts, concurrency profile. Can we assemble?

matt: Which timeframe and any request ids already captured?

priya: Window is 2026-03-10 02:10-02:40 UTC. Customer provided two Request IDs in their app logs: req_20260310_89a and req_20260310_8fb. They're willing to run a quick HAR for the span and share.

ada: quick checklist for repro pack: 1) 10 request IDs around spikes, 2) HAR or curl ids, 3) promptset (raw prompts + expected max token count), 4) concurrency profile (clients, QPS, backoffs), 5) SDK logs with X-Request-Id header.

matt: I'll need a curl that reproduces a single slow request. priya, can you ask them to run this (replace KEY/INPUT):

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rw-large-archived","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<PASTE_PROMPT>"}],"max_tokens":512}'
```

Ask them to capture response headers (esp x-request-id, x-server-latency) and full body. If they can get 5-10 of those that hit p95, attach them.

support-bot: Automated repro guide: please run our debug-bundle script to gather SDK logs + env + request id list. Link: https://internal.redwood.tools/debug-bundle. Defaults: 5m window, include network HAR.

karen: I can ping the customer for the HAR and 8 more request ids. Also confirm they used the JS SDK v2.3.1 and had batching enabled on their side (batch size ~8).

priya: Important: include token counts per request. They said average prompt tokens ~220, expected completion ~360 tokens. Please note any client-side retry/backoff config.

matt: For load replay we prefer vegeta — sample attack to reproduce their concurrency profile (25 concurrent clients, 60 rps for 2m):

```bash
echo 'POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY

{"model":"rw-large-archived","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<PASTE_PROMPT>"}],"max_tokens":512}' | 
vegeta attack -rate=60 -connections=25 -duration=2m | vegeta report
```

Also capture `vegeta report -type=json` and attach the report and raw results.

ada: If vegeta isn't available, `hey` or a small node replay script is fine — the key is matching the token distribution and concurrency, not just QPS. Provide a short CSV: timestamp, request_id, token_count_in, token_count_out, latency_ms.

priya: Customer will run the curl set and the debug-bundle this afternoon. I'll collect HAR + 12 request ids (they agreed).

matt: Once we have the bundle, I'll run a controlled replay against a canary model variant and capture server-side logs. If we see kv-cache churn or GC stalls, I'll flag it.

karen: One more ask from CS: include any billing anomalies — they saw a sudden token jump same window. Could be double-sends or retries.

priya: Noted. I'll ask them to include SDK request log (with attempts) and the app-side concurrency driver.

matt: If anyone can drop a quick sample of the CSV format we want, that'd help the customer.

ada: CSV example (one line per request):

```
2026-03-10T02:12:03Z,req_20260310_89a,220,360,1180
2026-03-10T02:12:10Z,req_20260310_8fb,218,345,1450
```

(priya: timestamp, request_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, latency_ms)

priya: Thanks — I'll push this to the customer and update thread when bundle lands. If they can attach HAR + vegeta results + the CSV, we're good to start the replay tomorrow. :thumbsup:

matt: Ack. Scheduling a 3pm run tomorrow if bundle arrives.

support-bot: Note: please mark ticket #CS-1448 with label `repro-pack-awaiting-bundle` so automation can pick it up.
